thread:
leah: Heads-up - Prospect (AlphaBank) pushed back: must use customer HSM for POC, provide rotation runbook, and complete security questionnaire. Pricing ask: trial discount if they supply HSM. cc @tom @harry

tom: We support CloudHSM and on-prem HSM via key-proxy. Two recommended POC flows: 1) live-proxy calls to their KMS (needs outbound 443), 2) pre-wrapped CEKs so no runtime KMS calls. Latency delta for proxy ~4ms avg (region dependent).

harry: Auditor Q: "do you ever store key material?" No. We only store key IDs/envelopes and audit logs. I'll attach a short attestation snippet.

saaS-bot: Uploaded: alpha_sec_qa_2026.pdf (by leah)

leah: They want rotation every 30 days at 03:00 local, and dry-run capability in staging. Also dual-custody for cutover.

tom: Zero-downtime rotation pattern: staged deployment + canary verify + rollback to previous CEK. We require the customer's unwrap credential available for acceptance tests. Example command for dry-run:
```bash
./rotate_test.sh --env staging --verify
```

harry: Network/runbook notes for customer:
- proxy-mode: allow outbound TLS to customer KMS endpoints (443)
- proxy mutual TLS optional
Firewall sample: "443/tcp, 123/udp"

gina: Pricing: If customer BYO-HSM and does wrapping for POC, offer 10-20% off POC fees and waive ingress egress for trial. Need legal to sign CMK addendum.

leah: Next actions: tom to confirm latency with infra, harry to prep attestation language & rotation playbook, gina to draft BYO discount quote, legal to prep addendum. Target sync Wed 9am PT.

tom: OK.

gina: On it.
